in_arabic.name: Murshidi
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Guide, Teacher, Spiritual Master
in_arabic.long_meaning: Murshidi هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic root sh-r-d, meaning to guide or teach. Murshid is a spiritual master or teacher in Sufism, the mystical branch of Islam. The Murshid helps the student on the path to enlightenment and personal growth.
